question:
Fill in the Blanks :

Had they submitted the proposal earlier, they ____ the funding.
solution:
The correct answer is '2' i.e. would have received.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is an example of the **third conditional**, which is used to describe unreal situations in the past.
 
• “Had they submitted” is the **inverted form** of “If they had submitted,” showing a past perfect structure.
 
• The structure of the third conditional is **Had + subject + past participle, would have + past participle**.
 
• Therefore, the correct verb form to complete the sentence is **Option 2.**

Correct sentence: *Had they submitted the proposal earlier, they **would have received** the funding.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **1st Conditional Sentence:**

 
 
• **Structure:** If + Present Simple, will + base verb.
 
• **Example:** If they submit the proposal now, they will receive the funding.
 
• **Usage:** Describes real or possible future situations.
 
 
 
• **2nd Conditional Sentence:**
 
 
• **Structure:** If + Past Simple, would + base verb.
 
• **Example:** If they submitted the proposal earlier, they would get the funding.
 
• **Usage:** Refers to hypothetical present or future situations.
